newsitem.title: USA: Baer Supply, Louis & Co acquired by Wurth Group.
newsitem.headline: Baer Supply, Louis & Co acquired by Wurth Group.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 30 - Wurth Group, a Germany-based firm, said on Thursday it acquired Baer Supply Co and Louis & Co for an undisclosed price.
The Wurth Group is in the wholesale fastener and fittings industry. Baer Supply, of Vernon Hills, Ill., is a regional distributor, primarily for cabinetry and fixture manufacturers and dealers.
Louis & Co, of Brea, Calif., distributes cabinet hardware, decorative surfacing products and woodworking machinery, mostly in the West and Southwest.
